summary.name: NailMoodLab
summary.one_liner: A web tool that generates AI nail design images from text prompts and palettes, offers nail shape guidance, and previews manicures on a photo of your hand.
keywords: save nail design for nail artist
use_cases: Generate a nail art design from a text description
Preview a manicure on a photo of your hand
Explore nail shapes before a salon visit
Save a design image to show your nail artist
Browse real manicure photos for inspiration
summary.what_it_does: The page offers an AI nail design generator: you pick a visual direction (palettes such as French Tip, Black Gloss, Pastel Shimmer) and write a description of colors, length, finish and details, and the tool creates a design image you can download. A Virtual Try-On feature lets you upload a well-lit hand photo and describe a style to see an AI preview on your hand. A shape guide suggests nail shapes from a clear hand photo, and the site also shows real manicure photographs for inspiration. Browsing ideas does not require an account, but using the AI features requires signing in.
notable: Text-prompt nail design generator with downloadable images
Virtual Try-On previews on an uploaded hand photo
Shape guide suggesting nail shapes from a hand photo
caveats: Free plan includes 5 AI actions per month; AI features require sign-in
Results depend on the image provider and the prompt; generation time varies
Previews are AI visualizations and shape suggestions are not a professional assessment
